summary: This Phase 3 study tests different combinations of medications, including prusogliptin, dapagliflozin, and metformin, in adults with type 2 diabetes. The goal is to see how well these drug combinations work for people whose blood sugar is not controlled well enough by metformin alone. CSPC Ouyi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is sponsoring this clinical trial with 815 participants. The current status of the study is Active, not recruiting.
